key_findings: Identical 7-feature model predictions across decentralized and centralized controllers (100.00% parity across 8,484 flows).
Identical model SHA-256 hashes across host VM, decentralized containers, and centralized image.
Centralized controller successfully manages per-service detection intervals (1.0s productpage, 5.0s backend).
Both controllers acquire the exact service-specific Lease (details-mitigation-lock) without cross-service interference.
Both controllers enforce monotonic fencing tokens and commit atomic single-write OCC patches.
Both controllers successfully execute autonomic recovery with zero human intervention upon traffic abatement.
Strict read-only safety guard verified: blocks all Lease acquisitions and VirtualService mutations during validation runs.

scientific_scope_note: This controlled trial validates the ML_ONLY autonomic recovery path (Stage 2: decoy quarantine teardown upon confirmed target client abatement). During ML_ONLY, production traffic remains on v1=100% throughout mitigation, making Stage 1 production restoration a NOP. Full two-stage recovery with separate production restoration (Stage 1 from v2/v3 back to v1) and subsequent decoy rule removal (Stage 2) will be systematically benchmarked under the BOTH attribution condition during the repeated trials.
